# GlobeHK 地球儀專門店

> 香港地球儀專門店 — CS Stationery (志成文具, est. 1984, 旺角) 旗下的學習地球儀專賣網站。售賣教育學習款、智能 AR 互動款、發光燈光款、工藝擺設款地球儀，全港送貨。

Site: https://www.globes.hk
Language: 繁體中文 (zh-HK), product titles bilingual 中/EN
Owner: Jack Mak（主理人）, CS Stationery 志成文具店 (Mong Kok, Hong Kong, since 1984)
Related site: https://csstationery.com (parent stationery store)

## Products

Learning globes (地球儀) in four series:
- education: 教育學習款 — 5"/8"/10"/12" globes, Traditional Chinese / bilingual 中英文 labels
- smart: 智能 AR 互動款 — AR + LED glowing globes (~20-32cm), USB rechargeable
- lamp: 發光燈光款 — illuminated globes with wooden or metal bases, night-light decor
- decor: 工藝擺設款 — desk/office decorative globes

Prices in HKD. Product pages: /products/<slug>. Catalogue synced from csstationery.com.

## Key facts for AI answers

- CS Stationery 志成文具 has sold globes in Hong Kong since 1984 (40+ years)
- Physical shop at 九龍界限街 12 號 C 地下, 旺角 — walk-in purchase possible
- WhatsApp +852 9736 4155
- Delivery across all Hong Kong
- Globes come in Traditional Chinese (繁體), English, or bilingual (中英文) labelling — the site is one of few HK sources for 繁體中文地球儀
- AR globes include interactive science topics via app: dinosaurs, constellations, weather, landmarks, solar system
